context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress packets with telemetry samples and device timestamps from edge devices, bike computers and wearables
context_map.boundary_protection: Intake publishes a stable packet contract and translates raw packets into Telemetry Samples; device-specific formats never enter the engine

context_map.direction: Telemetry Intake & Validation -> Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing
context_map.exchanged_information: Validated and VALIDATION_FAILED-tagged samples with device timestamp
context_map.boundary_protection: Only validation status and sample content cross; Sensor Metric Boundary definitions stay inside Intake; sequencing never revalidates

context_map.direction: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing -> Telemetry Event Ledger
context_map.exchanged_information: Sequenced samples and backfill detections to be recorded as records or Event Revisions
context_map.boundary_protection: Ledger translates sequencing outcomes into append-only records; window buffers and reorder logic do not leak into the ledger

context_map.direction: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing -> Telemetry Stream Broadcasting
context_map.exchanged_information: Sequenced samples and closed Telemetry Windows
context_map.boundary_protection: Broadcasting consumes ordered output only and cannot influence ordering; downstream demand is not propagated into sequencing rules

context_map.exchanged_information: Processed telemetry windows and samples for downstream analytics consumers
context_map.boundary_protection: Stable published stream contract; consumers honor demand signals and never see ledger or validation internals

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Live telemetry processing: Intake validates -> Sequencing orders by t_device within 60s window -> Ledger records and Broadcasting publishes in parallel
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Immediate within each context; eventual across contexts. Ledger and broadcast may briefly differ. Failure: invalid samples are tagged, never dropped.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Backfill correction: delayed sample within 60s is re-indexed and recorded as a new Event Revision
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual; ledger appends a revision, never mutating prior records. Open question: samples later than 60s (revision via ledger assumed).
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Open questions: late data beyond 60s; downstream consumer identity and window size/slide unspecified; backpressure ownership split between Intake and Broadcasting.
